segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵין נֶסֶךְ אָסוּר וְאוֹסֵר בְּכׇל שֶׁהוּא, יַיִן בְּיַיִן וּמַיִם בְּמַיִם בְּכׇל שֶׁהוּא, יַיִן בְּמַיִם וּמַיִם בְּיַיִן בְּנוֹתֵן טַעַם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Wine» used for «a libation» is «forbidden, and any amount» of it «renders» other wine «forbidden» if they are mixed together. «Wine» used for a libation that became mixed «with wine, or water» that was used for an idolatrous libation that became mixed «with» ordinary «water,» renders the mixture forbidden «with any amount» of the forbidden wine or water; but «wine» used for a libation that became mixed «with water, or water» used for a libation that became mixed «with wine» renders the mixture forbidden only if the forbidden liquid is sufficient «to impart flavor» to the mixture, i.e., for the wine to flavor the water or for the water to dilute the wine to an extent that can be tasted.

segments.he: זֶה הַכְּלָל: מִין בְּמִינוֹ — בְּמַשֶּׁהוּ, וְשֶׁלֹּא בְּמִינוֹ — בְּנוֹתֵן טַעַם.
segments.en: «This is the principle: A substance» in contact «with» the «same» type of «substance» renders the mixture forbidden «with any amount» of the forbidden substance, «but» a substance in contact «with a different» type of «substance» renders the mixture forbidden only «in» a case where it «imparts flavor» to it.

moves.cueHe: יין נסך אסור ואוסר בכל שהוא
moves.summary: libation wine forbids in any amount; wine in water by flavor
general principle: min bemino in any amount, other kinds by flavor

positions.claim: same kind forbids in any amount; different kind only when it imparts flavor
